subject: Next steps & scheduling: Technical deep dive with ML/Infra (60-90m)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Mills <sara@finovo.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@finovo.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposal for technical deep dive (60-90m)

Hi Sara / Tom,

Thanks for the call earlier — appreciate you walking through Finovo's high-level goals and the production challenges you're seeing with model latency and cost at peak loads. Quick recap from our side:

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while keeping 95th percentile latency under 200ms for customer-facing scoring.
- Current infra: mixed cloud GPUs, intermittent cold-starts, no KV cache for short-term user sessions.
- Compliance ask: data retention controls + audit logs for model inputs/outputs.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive where our ML infra engineers (Aditya and Dylan) join to:
1) review your current inference topology and traffic patterns
2) align on performance SLOs and acceptable cost tradeoffs
3) walk through Redwood's runtime options (batching, KV caching, quantization strategy) and Ops controls (routing, audit logs)
4) surface potential blockers and a mutual action plan for a pilot

Availability from our side next week (PT):
- Tue 5/12 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed 5/13 09:00–10:30

If you can confirm one slot or propose alternatives, I will loop in Aditya and Dylan and send a calendar invite with a draft agenda.

Attached: one-page proposed agenda (draft).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

(attachment: finovo-tdx-agenda.pdf (PDF))
